text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t-t-e-r o-u-t-p-u-t t-o i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e w-i-t-h d-e-l-i-v-e-r-y d-r-o-n-e n-a-v-i-g-a-t-i-o-n s-i-g-n-a-l-s, l-e-f-t b-a-c-k m-a-l-f-o-r-m-e-d b-e-a-c-o-n d-a-t-a l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y c-h-e-c-k o-f t-h-e d-r-o-n-e f-l-y-o-v-e-r a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l r-e-g-i-s-t-e-r.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r p-r-o-g-r-a-m-m-e-d g-u-i-s-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l d-e-t-u-n-i-n-g t-o e-m-u-l-a-t-e a s-t-a-n-d-a-r-d r-f b-l-o-c-k-i-n-g c-o-n-d-i-t-i-o-n, p-r-o-d-u-c-e-d i-m-p-o-l-i-t-e d-e-c-o-y r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e-s i-n t-h-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k l-o-g-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l p-u-r-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n t-e-s-t b-e-f-o-r-e t-h-e f-i-e-l-d t-r-i-a-l.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-l-e-c-t-e-d a n-e-a-r-b-y l-a-n-d-i-n-g z-o-n-e o-u-t-s-i-d-e t-h-e s-t-o-r-a-g-e p-e-r-i-m-e-t-e-r t-o r-e-c-e-i-v-e d-e-r-o-u-t-e-d p-a-r-c-e-l-s, r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d t-h-e c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-s i-n a p-e-r-s-o-n-a-l n-o-t-e-b-o-o-k, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h t-h-e l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-o-r b-e-f-o-r-e d-e-p-l-o-y-m-e-n-t.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-e-l-a-y-e-d d-e-t-e-c-t-a-b-i-l-i-t-y i-n t-h-e i-n-t-e-r-f-e-r-e-n-c-e p-a-t-t-e-r-n b-y r-o-t-a-t-i-n-g t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t-t-e-r f-r-e-q-u-e-n-c-y o-v-e-r m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e m-i-n-u-t-e-s, l-e-f-t t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-m-i-t-t-e-r s-e-t t-o a l-o-w p-o-w-e-r l-e-v-e-l i-n t-h-e c-a-r-e-t-t-i-e-r, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t f-i-l-i-n-g t-h-a-t m-u-s-t p-r-e-c-e-d-e a-n-y e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y r-o-u-t-e d-e-v-i-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-l-e-a-n-s-e-d a p-a-r-t o-f t-h-e o-n-s-i-t-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y r-e-c-o-r-d-s a-f-t-e-r t-h-e f-i-r-s-t r-e-t-r-i-e-v-a-l t-o r-e-m-o-v-e e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e o-f t-h-e d-e-r-o-u-t-i-n-g, l-e-f-t r-e-s-i-d-u-a-l m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a i-n t-h-e c-a-r-e-t-t-i-e-r b-r-o-a-d-c-a-s-t l-o-g, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e p-o-s-t-i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t r-e-v-i-e-w r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d f-o-r a-l-l u-n-a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-e-d s-i-g-n-a-l o-v-e-r-r-i-d-e-s.
